cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
path='modules/byte_program.py'
src=open(path).read()
anchor = 'def materialize(seq, lo, hi):'
funcs = '''def slice_seq(seq, lo, hi):
    """Byte slice ``seq[lo:hi]`` as a compressed sequence."""
    if lo >= hi:
        return EMPTY
    if lo == 0 and hi == seq.n:
        return seq
    parts = []
    stack = [('r', seq, lo, hi)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if item[0] == 's':
            parts.append(item[1])
            continue
        node, low, high = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        if low >= high:
            continue
        if low == 0 and high == node.n:
            parts.append(node)
            continue
        if node.tag == 'L':
            parts.append(leaf(node.a[low:high])
            continue
        stack.extend(reversed(list(_split(node, low, high))))
    return concat_all(parts)


def range_hash(seq, lo, hi):
    """Fingerprint (length, value) of ``seq[lo:hi]`` without materializing."""
    if lo >= hi:
        return 0, 0
    if lo == 0 and hi == seq.n:
        return seq.n, seq.h
    total_n = 0
    total_h = 0
    stack = [('r', seq, lo, hi)]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if item[0] == 's':
            node = item[1]
            total_h = (total_h * pow(BASE, node.n, MOD) + node.h) % MOD
            total_n += node.n
            continue
        node, low, high = item[1], item[2], item[3]
        if low >= high:
            continue
        if low == 0 and high == node.n:
            total_h = (total_h * pow(BASE, node.n, MOD) + node.h) % MOD
            total_n += node.n
            continue
        if node.tag == 'L':
            data = node.a[low:high]
            total_h = (total_h * pow(BASE, len(data), MOD) + hash_bytes(data)) % MOD
            total_n += len(data)
            continue
        stack.extend(reversed(list(_split(node, low, high))))
    return total_n, total_h


'''
funcs = funcs.replace("parts.append(leaf(node.a[low:high])\n", "parts.append(leaf(node.a[low:high]))\n")
src = src.replace(anchor, funcs + anchor, 1)
open(path,'w').write(src)
print('ok')
